evals.prompt: Please review the pull request for my current branch. Keep it read-only and tell me whether it is safe to merge. Focus on actual bugs, not style.
evals.expected_output: Pins the live PR state, examines the full diff and related context, runs practical verification where possible, and returns a concise evidence-based verdict without posting to GitHub.

evals.prompt: Re-review PR #482 after the author pushed a fix for the duplicate webhook delivery issue. Tell me whether the old finding is fixed, and post an inline blocking comment only if it is still broken.
evals.expected_output: Refreshes the PR state before reviewing, explicitly resolves the prior finding, checks adjacent retry and failure paths, avoids duplicate threads, and only posts after a final refresh if a finding remains.

evals.prompt: Review this PR and leave inline comments for any real issue. For each comment, use a Conventional Comment and add a details block with the evidence and minimal fix. Ignore formatting and naming issues.
evals.expected_output: Finds only well-supported behavioral issues, uses the requested comment structure, refreshes head and existing threads immediately before posting, and omits excluded style categories.
